snippet.title: Secrets of the Burrow: Vixoria's Quest - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Discover the story of Vixoria, a daring young Princess on a mighty quest! Accompanied by her begrudging companion, Sir Foxalot the Burrow's greatest knight!

From the creative minds at FOXBOY Productions, Secrets of the Burrow: Vixoria’s Quest is a 3D platformer inspired by classic animated films and packed with fast-paced combat, emotional storytelling, and a painted fairy-tale aesthetic, this is a journey you won’t forget.

Coming Soon
Wishlist now and follow us for updates!
